Looking at this qlang documentation, I'll work through each task carefully, understanding the pipeline syntax and verbs available.

Let me trace through the key concepts:
- `|` pipes values through steps
- `*` applies operations to each element
- `filter ~(...)` uses a quote (code block) with predicates
- `groupBy`, `sort`, `entries`, `json`/parsing work as described
- `/field` reads fields, `at` reads softly (returns null for missing)
- Case-insensitive comparisons use `lower` then equality checks

T1: `/data/users | filter ~(allOf /active (/email | ne null) (/email | lower | endsWith "@example.com")) | count`

T2: `/data/users | filter ~(any /roles ~(lower | eq "admin")) | sort ~(lower /name) | * (/name)`

T3: `/data/users | groupBy ~(at /profile/country | coalesce "unknown") | * (count)`

T4: `/data/users | filter ~(at /profile/age | ne null) | * (/profile/age) | avg | round 2`

T5: `filter ~(eq "open" /state) | * (/labels) | flat | * (/name) | * (lower) | distinct`

T6: `sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * {:number /number :assignee (at /assignee | if (eq null) ~(null) ~(at /login | coalesce null))}`

T7: `filter ~(eq "open" /state) | filter ~(at /assignee/login | ne null) | groupBy ~(at /assignee/login) | * (count)`

T8: `/dependencies | union (/devDependencies) | entries | filter ~(startsWith "^" /1) | * ~([(/0 | keyword) /1] | join "@") | sort`

T9: `/services | filter ~(allOf (at /enabled | coalesce false) (/port | gt 8000)) | * (/name | lower) | sort | join ","`

T10: `lines | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") | * (split " " | /2) | groupBy ~(.) | * (count)`

T11: `lines | filter ~(contains "ms=") | * (split "ms=" | /1 | split " " | /0 | parseJson) | avg | round 1`

T12: `lines | drop 1 | * (split ",") | * {id: (/0 | parseJson) customer: /1 product: /2 qty: (/3 | parseJson) price: (/4 | if (eq "") ~(null) ~(parseJson)) status: /5} | filter ~(allOf (/status | lower | eq "shipped") (/price | ne null)) | * (mulOf /qty /price) | sum | round 2`

T13: `lines | drop 1 | * (split ",") | * {customer: /1 qty: (/3 | parseJson) price: (/4 | if (eq "") ~(null) ~(parseJson)) status: /5} | filter ~(allOf (/status | lower | ne "cancelled") (/price | ne null)) | groupBy ~(/customer) | * (*(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | entries | sort ~(/1) | reverse | take 2 | * {customer: (/0 | keyword) total: (/1 | round 2)}`

T14: `["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] | * (lower) | distinct | sort ~([(/ | count | desc) /]) | join "-"`
